name: local-intercept
notes: Example: the page renders its list from /api/search, which answers 403 to anything that is not a browser (probe-http style requests fail). The collector opens each page in Chrome and reads the JSON the page itself received. Page 4 returns an empty items array, which ends the run. Runs against the fixture server: `node scripts/selftest.mjs --serve` (selftest itself starts the server on a free port and rewrites these URLs).
